identity.source: ADR-0013 部署形状 / ADR-0015 Instance Claim（旧变量检测拒绝启动）
identity.defect: Legacy ADMIN_EMAIL / ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD are detected by non-empty value, so variables explicitly set to an empty string pass as unset instead of refusing startup

findings.dispositionReason: Confirmed: the getenv seam cannot observe presence, and ADR-0013's harm model (old config silently ignored, instance unexpectedly open) applies to explicitly-set-but-empty values. Repair: presence-aware lookup seam.
evidence: server/internal/identity/module.go:50-57 — `if getenv(legacy) != ""` treats ADMIN_EMAIL="" as unset
ADR-0013: 检测到任一旧变量即以明确配置错误拒绝启动，防止旧配置被静默忽略后意外开放实例认领

identity.source: ADR-0015 Instance Claim（实例初始化后该配置不再产生效果）+ contracts/identity.yaml 事务顺序
identity.defect: Protected-mode missing-setup-code check runs before the advisory-lock emptiness recheck, so an initialized protected instance answers 400 invalid_request instead of 409 instance_already_initialized

findings.dispositionReason: Confirmed: configuration must have no effect after initialization; status already answers setup_code_required=false there, so the 400 contradicts the public contract.
evidence: server/internal/identity/auth/setup.go:205-211 — errSetupCodeRequired returned before the transaction's users-existence recheck
SetupStatus answers setup_code_required=false once initialized, but Initialize still enforces the code request shape
